name: Customer summary
description: Summarise a customer for a banker: the bank finds the customer by name and reads their record, and the advisor agent summarises that record with the customer id.

parameters.prompt: Summarise this customer for a banker from the record given; read nothing else unless the record is missing a field you need.

name: Levy case
description: One debtor of a garnishment notice: find the customer by name and address or the last four, then a reviewer holds funds or flags the customer.

nodes.name: Open a case for the unmatched debtor

input.text: Levy notice received: flagged, no hold placed.

name: Levy intake
description: A garnishment notice in the levy mailbox: read each debtor from its PDF and open a levy case per debtor.

name: Mailed document
description: One emailed document: read every debtor it names, a person checks a read below the floor, a levy case opens per debtor, and the sender gets an acknowledgement from the mailbox once a reviewer approves it.

parameters.title: Check the debtors read from the document

params.title: Send the acknowledgement to {$.input.from}?
params.reply: We received your document and opened a case for each person it names. Our team will contact you if anything else is needed.

input.subject: $.input.subject
input.body: We received your document and opened a case for each person it names. Our team will contact you if anything else is needed.

output.message: The acknowledgement was skipped: this notice did not arrive by email, so there is no mailbox or sender to reply to.

name: Mailed documents
description: Documents emailed to the intake mailbox: each attachment is read in its own run; files-service's limits decide what is stored, and the run lists what was skipped.

name: Read one levy document
description: One document of a levy email: its kind is detected, a doubtful read goes to a person, each kind is worked out and opens a case (a levy notice, one per person it names), and the outside system is told by webhook. Unknown kinds go to a person.

nodes.name: Detect the kind and read it

parameters.title: Decide what {$.input.name} is and handle it

name: Levy mail, mixed kinds
description: An email carrying levy documents of different kinds: each attachment is read in its own run, in parallel, and the sender gets a reply once a person acknowledges it.

params.title: Send the acknowledgement to {$.input.from}?
params.reply: We received your levy documents. Each one is being handled, and our team will contact you if anything else is needed.

input.subject: $.input.subject
input.body: We received your levy documents. Each one is being handled, and our team will contact you if anything else is needed.

output.message: The acknowledgement was skipped: this run has no mailbox or sender to reply to.

name: Levy documents, run with files
description: The same per-document handling as Levy mail, started from files uploaded in the console.

name: Hold on a customer's account
description: Finds the customer, works out how much can be held, and holds it once a person approves within four hours, or a supervisor after that; the hold opens a case and tells the outside system.

expressions.short: amount | string | replace(',', '') | float - min(amount | string | replace(',', '') | float, balance)

nodes.name: Note the hold on the case

name: Record what an attachment is
description: Recognises a file as one of the team's document types, reads it, and keeps the read on the file.

nodes.name: Keep the read on the file

name: Complaint email triage
description: A customer's complaint by email: each attachment is recognised and its read kept on the file, the complaint is read and triaged by an agent, it joins the customer's case or opens one, a hold starts when they ask for one, and they get a reply once a person approves it.

parameters.prompt: Read this customer complaint. Decide its urgency (high, normal or low), its category in two or three words, and whether the customer asks the bank to hold money on their account. Answer with the schema.

nodes.name: Do they ask for a hold?

params.title: Send this reply to {$.input.from}?
params.reply: Thank you for telling us. Your complaint is with our team, and we will contact you about it.

input.subject: $.input.subject
input.body: Thank you for telling us. Your complaint is with our team, and we will contact you about it.

output.message: The reply was skipped: this run has no mailbox or sender to reply to.
